outcome: adverse maternal or neonatal labour outcome
cohort: The study included 16,620 term deliveries performed by 210 obstetricians in a single year from a provincial database, excluding cases with diagnoses preventing active labour.
finding: The Vaginal Uncomplicated Delivery (VUD) rate, unlike the Cesarean Delivery (CD) rate, correlated with the Adverse Delivery (AD) rate, suggesting it is a better performance indicator for balancing maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: While both the Cesarean Delivery (CD) and Vaginal Uncomplicated Delivery (VUD) rates correlated with the mode of delivery, only the VUD rate was correlated to the Adverse Delivery (AD) rate.
